```{pyodide-python}

(U, S, V) = linalg.svd(img)
#Ths runs a a SVD on the img given above splitting it inot 3 parts the U complex unitary matrix, which is an invertible complex square matrix, where its invers equals its conjugate transpose, S is a rectangular diagonal matrix with non-negative real numbers on the diagonal.

ranks = [27, 25, 20, 15, 10, 5, 4, 3, 2, 1]

fig, ax = plt.subplots()
im = ax.imshow(img)
title = ax.set_title(f"Rank {ranks[0]}")

def update(frame):
    rank = ranks[frame]
    imgCompressed = U[:, 0:rank] @ np.diag(S[0:rank]) @ V[0:rank, :]
    im.set_data(imgCompressed)
    title.set_text(f"Rank {rank}")
    return im, title

ani = animation.FuncAnimation(fig, update, frames=len(ranks), interval=800, blit=False)
plt.show()
```
